sections.summary: Section 1 introduces VM0042 v2.2, an agricultural land management (ALM) methodology that quantifies GHG emission reductions (CO2, CH4, N2O) and carbon dioxide removals from improved ALM practices, with emphasis on soil organic carbon (SOC) storage. The crediting baseline uses a minimum three-year historical look-back period to model baseline emissions or directly measure SOC stock changes via baseline control sites. Additionality is established through barrier analysis and demonstrating that the implemented practice change is not common practice.

In hierarchical sampling designs, stratification must occur at the lowest quantification unit level, with strata reported in a spreadsheet annex at every verification. Grid and linear sampling are explicitly discouraged due to bias risk, and a minimum of 3-5 composite samples per stratum is required for model true-up or Quantification Approach 2.
